body:
I had been taking Diazepam as a recreational drug for about a year probably 1-2 times a week oraly. On this occasion I had been having pretty nasty fucking stomach cramps and didn't want to ingest anything at all so I decided to try a little experiment. I decded to administer the tablets into my cunt by way of an old syringe with the top cut off. Well guys I'll never go back to oral again. WOW.
Keep it sweet.
